text: Very thin material.  Not nearly as thick a I was looking for.. Had to send these back immediately.  These would be better than nothing, but are MUCH thinner than the ones I am trying to replace (due to cracking after 5 years).  Very thin, probably half of what my current ones are.  No thanks

product_metadata.title: KMAT 2PCS Kitchen Mat Cushioned Anti-Fatigue Floor Mat,Waterproof Non-Slip Standing Mat,Ergonomic Comfort Floor Mat Rug for Home,Office,Sink,Laundry,Desk(17.3"x28"+17.3"x60",Grey)
features: 2PCS High Quality Kitchen Mat--- Set includes 2 pack of kitchen rugs (17.3 x 28 inches and 17.3 x 60 inches). The KMAT kitchen mats are made of premium PVC material that is phathalate-free, latex-free, and odor-free. The eco-friendly kitchen rug are constructed with premium strength material to ensure that the mats will keep their shape, even with extended and heavy use.

COMFORT--- The KMAT anti-fatigue kitchen floor mat provides thick, cushioned support to help improve circulation and posture and to ensure that you are able to stand comfortably while working in the kitchen or at any work station. Perfect for hair stylists and anyone who stands for long periods of time.

Easy to Clean Surface ---This gel kitchen floor mat is easily cleaned--simply wipe down the dirt with a damp cloth or vacuum as needed. The waterproof kitchen mats and rugs ensures long-term durability and superior comfort.

Anti-Slip --- The KMAT cushioned anti-fatigue comfort mat is designed with a unique beveled edge. The water-resistant top area has an attractive texture and the underside is super non-slip bottom, helpful to prevent tripping & slipping. [NOTE] Open rug fully place on even, flat, dry floor. Water under rug may result in slippage. Rug must be placed on dry surface during use.

MULTI PURPOSE --- The anti fatigue mat provides an extra large activity area in laundry room, kitchen, office or any other high-traffic place. The neutral color matches any décor and it is a great gift for your family if you take good care of your health and well-being.
